analysis: experimental target-map reliability and exact same-support docking--experiment geometry

broad_reference.definition: complete DOCKSTRING support after excluding every row whose raw InChIKey connectivity block occurs in DAVIS or PKIS2

central_data_boundary: Only repository-redistributed DAVIS, PKIS2 and DOCKSTRING source tables are used for the central results.

cross_panel_experimental_geometry.interpretation: Independent-panel agreement is an external reproducibility benchmark, not a formal noise ceiling, because assay technology and chemical support differ between panels.
Independent-panel agreement is an external reproducibility benchmark, not a formal noise ceiling, because assay technology and chemical support differ between panels.

methods_boundary.bootstrap: paired perturbation/sampling ranges conditional on each fixed target panel; not target-superpopulation intervals
methods_boundary.full_support_reliability: not extrapolated from halves: Spearman--Brown is inapplicable to this nonlinear map statistic
methods_boundary.noise_ceiling: no classical attenuation ceiling is reported because docking and experiment cannot be assumed to measure one latent construct
methods_boundary.oas: Oracle Approximating Shrinkage covariance converted to a correlation matrix; finite-sample estimator sensitivity
methods_boundary.split_half: disjoint halves are the repeatability estimate; chemical-cluster splits never place one Butina cluster in both halves

chemical_cluster_support.method: RDKit Morgan radius-2, 2048-bit fingerprints with Butina clustering at Tanimoto similarity 0.65 (distance 0.35), as redistributed public-panel loader

map_reliability.interpretation: The disjoint-half Spearman is the repeatability diagnostic at the observed half-panel size. No Spearman--Brown extrapolation is made. Sign and top-decile overlap are compared with complete target-label relabeling because row centring induces a shared compositional constraint. Half-to-full quantities are recovery diagnostics, not independent reliability estimates.

same_support_reliability.interpretation: The experimental half--half map agreement is a direct repeatability benchmark at half the observed ligand count; it is not extrapolated. The cross-modal ratio is descriptive and not bounded by one. The same-minus-cross-half contrast estimates optimism from sharing the same finite ligand draw, and the target-label null handles the dependence among map edges.
